_about: Closed meaning library for the paid chart report. Core entries (with an ebook page in 'p') match the free ebook 'Read Your Own Chart' v2 and must stay the same. Fields drives, likes, dislikes, drains, needs, pulls, short, readAsYou and practical are report-only. The report writer may use ONLY these meanings.

Sun.means: Who you are. Your energy and the person you are growing into.

Moon.means: Feelings, needs. What makes you feel safe.

Mercury.means: Mind, words. How you think and learn.

Venus.means: Love and beauty. What you value and enjoy.

Mars.means: Energy, desire, anger. How you go after what you want.

Jupiter.means: Growth and luck. Where life opens up for you.

Saturn.means: Rules and lessons. Where you get good at things slowly, through hard work.

Uranus.means: Change, freedom. Where you break the rules.

Neptune.means: Dreams and imagination. Where you look for magic, or try to escape.

Pluto.means: Power and big change. Where you go through deep changes.

strongVsChallenged.text: 'Strong in' is the sign where a planet works at its best. 'Challenged in' lists signs where it has a harder time. A challenged planet has to work harder, and it often grows wiser for it.

generational.text: Everyone born around the same year has the outer planets in the same signs. What makes them personal to you is the house they sit in and the aspects they make to your other planets.

Aries.gift: starts things others only talk about.
Aries.ask: Where do I need to be brave?
Aries.drives: the wish to act first and start new things.
Aries.likes: challenges, speed and being free to go first.
Aries.dislikes: waiting, slow people and being told to sit still.
Aries.drains: long delays, too many rules and no room to act.
Aries.needs: a clear goal, space to move and a chance to lead.
Aries.love: a partner who keeps up with you and loves a bit of fire.
Aries.partner: people who are bold, quick and not afraid to take the lead.
Aries.work: work where you can start things, compete and act fast.
Aries.workday: short tasks, quick wins and room to go your own way.
Aries.step: Pick one thing you have put off and start it today, even for ten minutes.

Taurus.gift: patience that builds things to last.
Taurus.drives: the wish to build something safe that lasts.
Taurus.likes: good food, nice things, nature and calm routines.
Taurus.dislikes: rush, sudden change and being pushed.
Taurus.drains: chaos, money worries and a messy, noisy place.
Taurus.needs: a calm home, steady plans and time to do things slowly.
Taurus.love: steady love, touch, loyalty and time to trust.
Taurus.partner: people who are calm, loyal and good with their hands.
Taurus.work: work you can build slowly, with real things you can see and touch.
Taurus.workday: a calm place, a steady routine and no rush.
Taurus.step: Make one meal or one corner of your home a little more pleasant this week.

Gemini.shadow: gets bored fast, finds it hard to focus.
Gemini.ask: What am I curious about right now?
Gemini.drives: curiosity and the wish to learn and share new things.
Gemini.likes: talk, new ideas, books, short trips and variety.
Gemini.dislikes: boredom, the same routine every day and slow talk.
Gemini.drains: too much of the same, silence and no one to talk to.
Gemini.needs: people to talk with, new things to learn and room to change plans.
Gemini.love: good talks, fun and a partner who keeps you curious.
Gemini.partner: people who are clever, chatty and full of ideas.
Gemini.work: work with words, people, ideas and plenty of variety.
Gemini.workday: many small tasks, chats with people and new things to learn.
Gemini.step: Ask one person a question you have never asked them before.

Cancer.shadow: moody, hides behind a hard shell.
Cancer.ask: Who and what do I want to protect?
Cancer.drives: the wish to care for people and keep them safe.
Cancer.likes: home, family, old memories and people who stay.
Cancer.dislikes: coldness, harsh words and feeling pushed away.
Cancer.drains: fights at home, no privacy and people who do not care back.
Cancer.needs: a safe home, close people and time to feel things through.
Cancer.love: warmth, safety and a partner who feels like home.
Cancer.partner: people who are caring, gentle and close to their family.
Cancer.work: work where you look after people or build a safe place.
Cancer.workday: a friendly team, a safe place and work that feels useful.
Cancer.step: Call or text someone close and ask how they really are.

Leo.gift: generous heart, lights up a room.
Leo.ask: Where do I want to shine?
Leo.drives: the wish to create and to be seen for it.
Leo.likes: fun, praise, warm people and doing things with style.
Leo.dislikes: being ignored, small roles and cold people.
Leo.drains: no thanks for your work and no space to shine.
Leo.needs: people who see you, praise your work and share your joy.
Leo.love: warm praise, loyalty and a partner who is proud of you.
Leo.partner: people who are warm, proud and fun to be around.
Leo.work: work where you can shine, create or lead a team.
Leo.workday: a chance to be seen, to create and to get thanks for your work.
Leo.step: Do one thing this week just because it is fun for you.

Virgo.gift: makes things better, one detail at a time.
Virgo.shadow: worries a lot, too hard on itself.
Virgo.ask: What small habit would help me most?
Virgo.drives: the wish to be useful and make things work well.
Virgo.likes: order, clear tasks, useful skills and helping others.
Virgo.dislikes: mess, careless work and plans that make no sense.
Virgo.drains: chaos, sloppy work around you and too much to fix.
Virgo.needs: a clear plan, a tidy space and work that helps someone.
Virgo.love: small acts of care, help and a partner you can rely on.
Virgo.partner: people who are tidy, helpful and good at details.
Virgo.work: work where you fix, sort, improve or help people.
Virgo.workday: a clear list, time for details and a tidy place.
Virgo.step: Write down three things you did well today, not only what went wrong.

Libra.gift: sees both sides and keeps the peace.
Libra.shadow: can't make up its mind, avoids arguments at any cost.
Libra.ask: Where do I need more give and take?
Libra.drives: the wish for fairness, beauty and good relationships.
Libra.likes: kind people, nice places, art and calm talks.
Libra.dislikes: fights, rude people and having to take sides.
Libra.drains: arguments, unfair treatment and ugly or tense places.
Libra.needs: peace around you, fair people and someone to share things with.
Libra.love: fairness, kind words and a partner who is an equal.
Libra.partner: people who are kind, fair and easy to be with.
Libra.work: work with people, beauty or fairness, like design or bringing sides together.
Libra.workday: a nice place, kind people and a fair share of the work.
Libra.step: Make one small choice today without asking anyone else first.

Scorpio.gift: brave enough to face hard truths.
Scorpio.ask: What am I ready to let go of?
Scorpio.drives: the wish to go deep and find the truth.
Scorpio.likes: real talks, secrets, deep bonds and hard questions.
Scorpio.dislikes: lies, small talk and people who are fake.
Scorpio.drains: broken trust, betrayal and feeling out of control.
Scorpio.needs: people you can trust fully and space to be private.
Scorpio.love: deep trust, honesty and a partner who is all in.
Scorpio.partner: people who are deep, strong and a bit of a mystery.
Scorpio.work: work where you dig deep, find what is hidden or help people change.
Scorpio.workday: time alone to focus, and tasks you can go deep into.
Scorpio.step: Tell one person you trust something true that you usually keep inside.

Sagittarius.shadow: promises too much, can be too blunt.
Sagittarius.ask: What do I want to learn or explore?
Sagittarius.drives: the wish to explore, learn and find meaning.
Sagittarius.likes: travel, big ideas, freedom and honest people.
Sagittarius.dislikes: small rules, closed minds and being tied down.
Sagittarius.drains: the same routine, no new places and no hope.
Sagittarius.needs: freedom, a goal that means something and new places to see.
Sagittarius.love: fun, freedom and a partner to explore life with.
Sagittarius.partner: people who are open, funny and love to travel or learn.
Sagittarius.work: work with travel, teaching, big ideas or room to grow.
Sagittarius.workday: freedom to move, new things to learn and not too many rules.
Sagittarius.step: Learn one new thing this week, just because you are curious.

Capricorn.gift: reaches big goals step by step.
Capricorn.shadow: too strict, all work and no rest.
Capricorn.ask: What am I building, and why?
Capricorn.drives: the wish to reach big goals and be respected.
Capricorn.likes: clear goals, hard work that pays off and respect.
Capricorn.dislikes: laziness, wasted time and plans with no point.
Capricorn.drains: no progress, no structure and people who break promises.
Capricorn.needs: a clear plan, real results and people who take you seriously.
Capricorn.love: loyalty, respect and a partner who builds a life with you.
Capricorn.partner: people who are serious, hard-working and know what they want.
Capricorn.work: work with clear goals, where you can climb step by step.
Capricorn.workday: a clear plan, clear roles and work that leads somewhere.
Capricorn.step: Take one hour this week to rest, with no work at all.

Aquarius.keywords: Original · friendly · wants a better world
Aquarius.gift: dreams up a better future for everyone.
Aquarius.shadow: can seem cold, likes to go against the crowd.
Aquarius.ask: Where am I different, on purpose?
Aquarius.drives: the wish to be free and make the world better.
Aquarius.likes: new ideas, friends, causes and doing things your own way.
Aquarius.dislikes: being told to fit in and old ways with no reason.
Aquarius.drains: too much control, closed minds and no room to be yourself.
Aquarius.needs: freedom, friends who think like you and a cause you believe in.
Aquarius.love: friendship first, space to be yourself and a partner who gets your ideas.
Aquarius.partner: people who are different, free and a bit ahead of their time.
Aquarius.work: work with new ideas, tech or groups that want to change things.
Aquarius.workday: freedom to do it your way, and smart people around you.
Aquarius.step: Join one group, chat or event about something you care about.

Pisces.gift: feels deeply for others, very artistic.
Pisces.shadow: runs away from problems, finds it hard to say no.
Pisces.ask: Where do I need to say no more often?
Pisces.drives: the wish to feel, create and help others.
Pisces.likes: music, art, dreams, calm time alone and kind people.
Pisces.dislikes: harsh people, cold rules and loud fights.
Pisces.drains: conflict, too many demands and no time alone to rest.
Pisces.needs: calm time alone, kind people and a way to create or dream.
Pisces.love: gentle care, deep feeling and a partner who understands without words.
Pisces.partner: people who are kind, dreamy and creative.
Pisces.work: work with art, music or helping people, where you can use your feelings.
Pisces.workday: a calm place, soft deadlines and time for your own ideas.
Pisces.step: Spend twenty quiet minutes with music, art or nature, with your phone away.

1.detail: how you look and come across
1.question: How do I meet the world?
1.pulls: being yourself, your looks and how you start things.

2.question: What do I value and earn?
2.pulls: earning, saving, owning good things and knowing your worth.

3.question: How do I think and talk every day?
3.pulls: talking, writing, learning and people close by.

4.question: Where do I belong?
4.pulls: home, family and a private place of your own.

5.question: What makes me feel alive?
5.pulls: fun, romance, play, hobbies and making things.

6.question: How do I care for my days and body?
6.pulls: daily habits, useful work and helping others.

7.question: Who do I commit to, and how?
7.pulls: partners, close one-to-one bonds and working as a pair.

8.question: What do I share deeply, and what do I let go of?
8.pulls: deep closeness, shared money and life changes.

9.question: What gives my life meaning?
9.pulls: travel, study and big questions about life.

10.question: What do I want to be known for?
10.pulls: your job, your goals and what people know you for.

11.question: Who are my people, and what future do we want?
11.pulls: friends, groups, causes and hopes for the future.

12.question: What do I need to heal or release?
12.pulls: rest, dreams, time alone and your inner world.

angular.text: Houses 1, 4, 7, 10. The strongest houses. Planets here act boldly and in the open.

succedent.text: Houses 2, 5, 8, 11. Where you build up what you have and feel secure.

cadent.text: Houses 3, 6, 9, 12. Where you learn, adapt and get ready for what comes next.

fire.lots: Bold and eager; may burn out.
fire.little: May need help finding energy and confidence.

earth.lots: Practical and reliable; may get stuck.
earth.little: Needs to look after routines and health.

water.lots: Feels others' moods strongly; may soak them up.
water.little: Feelings may be hard to name.

_missing.text: If an element is missing, you tend to look for it in other people and in what you do.

cardinal.means: Starts. Cardinal signs start each season.

fixed.means: Keeps going. Fixed signs sit in the middle of a season.

mutable.means: Adapts. Mutable signs lead into the next season.

conjunction.readAs: A and B act as one.
conjunction.readAsYou: In you, A and B act as one.

sextile.readAs: A helps B when I make the effort.
sextile.readAsYou: A helps B when you make the effort.

square.readAs: A pushes against B, and that pushes me to act.
square.readAsYou: A pushes against B, and that pushes you to act.

trine.readAs: A and B support each other naturally.
trine.readAsYou: A and B support each other, so this comes easily to you.

opposition.readAs: A and B pull in opposite ways. I often notice this through other people.
opposition.readAsYou: A and B pull you in opposite ways. You often notice this through other people.

semi-square.keyword: A small irritation that keeps nagging

quincunx.keyword: Two things that never quite fit, so you keep adjusting

Ascendant.means: Your approach to life and how others first see you.

Midheaven.means: Your career and the path you want to be known for.

NorthNode.means: Where you are meant to grow. It feels new, but it's rewarding.

SouthNode.means: Natural talents and old habits. You can lean on them or get stuck in them.

Chiron.means: A sore spot in your life. When you work on it, it becomes your gift for helping others.

Lilith.means: Your wild side: the part of you that won't be told what to do.

Fortune.means: Where things come easily and make you happy.

Vertex.means: Meetings and turning points that feel meant to be.

_nodes.text: The South Node shows your comfort zone. The North Node shows where you are meant to grow. Read both by sign and house.

stellium.means: 3 or more planets in one sign or house. A lot of focus on that part of life.

t-square.means: Two planets opposite each other, and a third at a right angle to both. Lots of drive, under pressure.

grand-trine.means: Three planets in a triangle, usually in one element. A natural gift, but it's easy to get lazy with it.

grand-cross.means: Four planets, each square to two others and opposite the fourth. A lot of tension that builds great strength.

yod.means: Two planets 60° apart, both 150° from a third. The planet at the tip gives a strong sense of purpose.

kite.means: A grand trine with a fourth planet opposite one of the three. A talent with a clear goal to aim at.

angles.text: A planet close to the AC, MC, DC or IC (within about 5°) is extra strong. It shows up in your whole personality.

AC.text: The sign that was coming up over the eastern horizon when you were born.

MC.text: The top of the chart. It is about your career and the path people see you take.

DC.text: Opposite the AC. It is about partners.

IC.text: Opposite the MC. It is about home and family.

New.means: Starts things on instinct, lives in the moment.

Crescent.means: Pushes past old habits to grow.

First quarter.means: Makes quick decisions, enjoys a challenge.

Gibbous.means: Likes to improve things and find meaning.

Full.means: Very aware of others, focused on relationships.

Disseminating.means: Natural teacher, shares what it knows.

Balsamic.means: Dreamy and wise, good at endings and fresh starts.

_about.text: The moon phase you were born under says something about your rhythm in life.

_general.text: From Earth, planets sometimes look like they are moving backwards. In a birth chart, a retrograde planet works in a quieter, more private way.

Mercury.means: Thinks before speaking. Learns in its own way and likes to go back over ideas.

Venus.means: Decides for itself what love and beauty mean, often after questioning the usual ideas.

Mars.means: Uses its energy quietly and with a plan. Deals with anger inside before showing it.

Jupiter.means: Works out its own beliefs instead of copying other people's.

Saturn.means: Sets its own rules. Can be very hard on itself until it learns self-respect.

outer.means: Very common for Uranus, Neptune and Pluto. Their effects are felt mostly on the inside.

chartRuler.text: The planet that rules your Rising sign. Its sign and house show where your energy tends to go.

transits.text: Compare where the planets are today with your birth chart. It shows what is going on in your life right now.

synastry.text: Put two people's charts together to see how they get along and where they clash.

progressions.text: Your birth chart is moved forward slowly, one day for each year of your life. It shows how you grow and change on the inside.

saturnReturn.text: When Saturn comes back to where it was when you were born, at about age 29.
saturnReturn.practical: Life may ask you to check your work, duties and promises, and keep what is real.

tension._about: Report-only. Real-life examples for each red line (square or opposition) between two planets. Printed by code under the red line. The owner approved them on 2026-10-26. Sun-Mercury, Sun-Venus, Mercury-Venus and Neptune-Pluto never form one in a living person.
Sun-Moon: What you want to do and how you feel about it may not match.
You may push ahead with a plan while a part of you feels unsafe.
You may feel torn between what you want for yourself and what you need to feel at home.
Sun-Mars: You may get angry fast when someone blocks what you want.
You may push too hard and then feel tired out.
You may start fights you did not mean to start.
Sun-Jupiter: You may say yes to too much and then cannot do it all.
You may expect things to work out and skip the small steps.
You may want more and more, and find it hard to feel it is enough.
Sun-Saturn: You may feel you must earn the right to be yourself.
You may hold back from showing your work until it is perfect.
You may hear a strict inner voice that says "not good enough".
Sun-Uranus: You may feel boxed in by plans, and suddenly change them.
You may leave a job or a group when it starts to feel like a cage.
You may want to be different, even when it costs you.
Sun-Neptune: You may not be sure who you are, and copy the people around you.
You may dream big and then avoid the real steps.
You may give too much of yourself to someone and feel lost after.
Sun-Pluto: You may fight for control when you feel weak.
You may go through big changes where an old part of you ends.
You may feel strong pressure from a powerful person, like a boss or a parent.
Moon-Mercury: Your head may say one thing while your feelings say another.
You may talk about facts when you really want comfort.
You may think about a feeling so much that it gets bigger.
Moon-Venus: What you need to feel safe and what you enjoy may not match.
You may want a calm home but fall for exciting people.
You may give up what you enjoy to keep the peace at home.
Moon-Mars: Your mood may flip to anger fast when you feel hurt.
You may snap at people close to you when you are stressed.
You may find it hard to rest, even when you are tired.
Moon-Jupiter: You may feel everything a lot, the good and the bad.
You may do too much of a good thing to feel better.
You may promise more care than you can give.
Moon-Saturn: You may feel you must hide your feelings to be strong.
You may find it hard to ask for help or comfort.
You may feel alone, even with people around you.
Moon-Uranus: Your moods may change fast, without a clear reason.
You may want closeness and then need space right after.
You may feel restless at home and want to move or change things.
Moon-Neptune: You may watch a series for hours instead of facing a hard feeling.
You may pick up other people's moods and not know which feeling is yours.
You may picture an event in your head, and then the real thing feels flat.
Moon-Pluto: Your feelings may run very deep and strong.
You may hold on to a hurt for a long time.
You may try to control your home or close people to feel safe.
Mercury-Mars: You may say sharp words when you are angry.
You may argue to win, not to understand.
Your mind may race, and you may decide too fast.
Mercury-Jupiter: You may talk big and skip the details.
You may take on too many ideas or courses at once.
You may feel sure you are right before you check the facts.
Mercury-Saturn: You may doubt your own ideas and stay quiet.
You may learn slowly, but you remember well.
You may fear saying something wrong in front of others.
Mercury-Uranus: Your thoughts may jump fast from one idea to the next.
You may say surprising things that others do not expect.
You may get bored with slow lessons and stop listening.
Mercury-Neptune: You may daydream when you need to focus.
You may forget details, dates or what someone said.
You may believe a nice story without checking it.
Mercury-Pluto: You may dig deep for the truth and not let a question go.
You may use words to control a talk or win a fight.
You may keep your real thoughts secret.
Venus-Mars: What you love and what you desire may pull you different ways.
You may want peace in love but also want excitement.
You may move fast in love, then wonder if it fits you.
Venus-Jupiter: You may enjoy too much of a good thing.
You may expect a lot from love and then feel let down.
You may say yes to every fun plan and end up tired.
Venus-Saturn: You may feel that love must be earned.
You may hold back in love because you fear being hurt.
You may find it hard to enjoy things without feeling guilty.
Venus-Uranus: You may want love and freedom at the same time.
You may fall for someone fast and lose interest fast.
You may like unusual people or styles that others do not get.
Venus-Neptune: You may fall for the idea of a person, not the real person.
You may buy something for the dream an ad sells.
In love, you may give too much and miss the warning signs.
Venus-Pluto: You may love very deeply and fear losing the person.
You may feel jealous, or hold on too tight.
You may find that love changes you a lot, in a strong way.
Mars-Jupiter: You may take on too much and run out of energy.
You may take big risks because you feel sure it works.
You may push for more when it is time to stop.
Mars-Saturn: You may feel blocked when you go after what you want.
You may hold your anger in until it comes out all at once.
You may work very hard but feel your effort is never enough.
Mars-Uranus: You may act suddenly, without a plan.
You may get angry fast when someone tells you what to do.
You may take risks to feel free.
Mars-Neptune: You may lose energy when you do not know what you want.
You may avoid a fight, then feel angry later.
You may start things with big dreams and not finish them.
Mars-Pluto: You may feel very strong anger when you feel controlled.
You may push yourself very hard to win.
You may get pulled into power games with bosses or strong people.
Jupiter-Saturn: You may feel torn between going for more and playing it safe.
You may grow in steps: a push forward, then a step back.
Your hopes and your duties may not match.
Jupiter-Uranus: You may want big change and freedom right now.
You may jump at new chances without checking them.
You may get restless when life feels too normal.
Jupiter-Neptune: You may hope too much and see only the good side.
You may believe in people or ideas that later let you down.
You may want a perfect life and find real life hard to accept.
Jupiter-Pluto: You may want a lot of power or success.
You may push hard to grow, even when others resist.
You may go all in, with no middle way.
Saturn-Uranus: You may feel torn between safety and freedom.
You may build a stable life, then want to break out of it.
You may follow the rules and also want to break them.
Saturn-Neptune: Your dreams and the real world may seem far apart.
You may doubt a dream and drop it before you try.
You may feel lost when rules and plans fall apart.
Saturn-Pluto: You may feel heavy pressure to stay in control.
You may go through hard times that make you much stronger.
You may find it hard to let go of plans, jobs or habits.
Uranus-Neptune: You may feel torn between big change and quiet dreams.
You may jump at new ideas and then feel unsure about them.
You may find it hard to tell new ideas from wishful thinking.
Uranus-Pluto: You may want big change and feel strongly about it.
You may feel pushed to break with old ways.
You may feel restless when things stay the same for long.

theme._about: Report-only. The owner approved them on 2026-10-27. Theme tags shared by signs, runes and life path numbers. The code compares the tags of the Sun sign, the birth rune and the life path number.
theme.partnership: partnership and fair give and take
theme.structure: order, plans and building step by step
theme.care: care, home and the people close to you

rune._about: Report-only. The owner approved them on 2026-10-27. The 24 Elder Futhark runes in the order of the modern runic calendar of Nigel Pennick. Meanings in our own words, based on the Old English, Norwegian and Icelandic rune poems and the common modern meaning. 'practice' holds reflection habits, never rituals.

Fehu.means: what you have and what you earn, and sharing it.
Fehu.gift: you can build up good things and share them.
Fehu.shadow: holding on too tight, or giving away too much.
practice: Each evening, write down one thing you earned or got today.
Ask yourself: what do I have that I can share?

Uruz.means: wild strength, a strong drive and staying power.
Uruz.gift: you keep going when others stop.
Uruz.shadow: pushing too hard and not knowing when to rest.
practice: Ask each morning: where do I need my strength today?
Write down one hard thing you did this week.

Thurisaz.means: a sharp thorn: a force that guards and pushes back.
Thurisaz.gift: you can stand up for yourself and for others.
Thurisaz.shadow: hitting back too fast, or hurting people without meaning to.
practice: Before you react, count to five and ask: is this worth a fight?
Write down one limit you kept this week.

Ansuz.means: the mouth: words, messages and wise speech.
Ansuz.gift: your words can teach, calm and inspire.
Ansuz.shadow: talking without listening, or not saying what you mean.
practice: Ask each day: what do I really want to say?
Write down one thing you heard today that made you think.

Raidho.means: the ride: travel, rhythm and the right order of things.
Raidho.gift: you know when it is time to move and which way to go.
Raidho.shadow: rushing ahead, or feeling lost without a plan.
practice: Each morning, name one step that moves you forward.
Take a short walk or ride and think about where you are going.

Kenaz.means: the torch: light, skill and learning.
Kenaz.gift: you learn fast and can show others the way.
Kenaz.shadow: burning out, or getting stuck in your own head.
practice: Ask each evening: what did I learn today?
Spend ten minutes on a skill you want to grow.

Gebo.means: the gift: giving, taking and fair exchange between people.
Gebo.gift: you build strong bonds through fair give and take.
Gebo.shadow: giving too much to be liked, or keeping score.
practice: Each morning, ask: what can I give today, and what can I let myself take?
Before bed, write down one gift you gave and one you got.

Wunjo.means: joy: feeling at home with yourself and your people.
Wunjo.gift: you bring good mood and a sense of belonging to a group.
Wunjo.shadow: needing everyone to be happy, or fearing to stand out.
practice: Write down one thing that made you smile today.
Ask yourself: where do I feel I belong?

Hagalaz.means: hail: a sudden storm that clears the way for something new.
Hagalaz.gift: you can get through hard times and start again.
Hagalaz.shadow: fear of change, or making storms where none are needed.
practice: When something goes wrong, ask: what can grow from this?
Write down one hard time you got through, and what it taught you.

Nauthiz.means: need: hard times that teach you what really matters.
Nauthiz.gift: you stay strong and patient when life is tight.
Nauthiz.shadow: feeling there is never enough, or carrying hardship alone.
practice: Ask yourself: what do I really need right now, and what can wait?
Write down one thing a hard time taught you.

Isa.means: ice: stillness, focus and a time to pause.
Isa.gift: you can stay calm and focused when others panic.
Isa.shadow: freezing up, or keeping people at a distance.
practice: Sit still for five minutes each day and notice your thoughts.
Ask yourself: what in my life needs a pause?

Jera.means: the year: harvest, cycles and the reward for patient work.
Jera.gift: you know good things take time and you keep working.
Jera.shadow: wanting results too fast, or giving up before the harvest.
practice: Each week, write down one thing you planted and one thing you reaped.
Ask yourself: what am I growing, slowly, right now?

Eihwaz.means: the yew tree: deep roots, staying power and steady change.
Eihwaz.gift: you stay steady through big changes.
Eihwaz.shadow: being too hard on yourself, or refusing to bend.
practice: Ask each morning: what keeps me steady?
Write down one change you lived through and how you stayed yourself.

Perthro.means: the game: chance, mystery and the unknown.
Perthro.gift: you can live with not knowing and see hidden things.
Perthro.shadow: leaving everything to luck, or keeping too many secrets.
practice: Ask yourself: what do I not know yet, and can I be OK with that?
Write down one surprise from this week and what it showed you.

Algiz.means: the elk sedge: protection and a strong sense of what is safe.
Algiz.gift: you sense danger early and look after others.
Algiz.shadow: being too careful, or shutting people out to stay safe.
practice: Ask each day: what makes me feel safe, and is it still true?
Write down one person you looked after this week.

Sowilo.means: the sun: light, success and a clear way ahead.
Sowilo.gift: you shine, give hope and lead by example.
Sowilo.shadow: needing to win, or burning too bright and getting tired.
practice: Each morning, name one thing you want to get done today.
Write down one win from today, even a small one.

Tiwaz.means: the guiding star: honour, fairness and keeping your word.
Tiwaz.gift: you do what is right, even when it costs you.
Tiwaz.shadow: being too strict, or giving up too much for a cause.
practice: Ask yourself: what promise do I want to keep this week?
Write down one time you stood up for what is fair.

Berkano.means: the birch tree: new growth, care and fresh starts.
Berkano.gift: you help people and plans grow, slowly and gently.
practice: Ask each morning: what small new thing can I start or care for today?
Write down one way you looked after yourself this week.

Ehwaz.means: the horse: trust, teamwork and moving forward together.
Ehwaz.gift: you work well with a partner and build trust.
Ehwaz.shadow: leaning on others too much, or changing too often.
practice: Ask yourself: who helps me move forward, and do I thank them?
Write down one thing you did well with someone else.

Mannaz.means: the human: the self, other people and how we need each other.
Mannaz.gift: you understand people and yourself well.
Mannaz.shadow: thinking too much about what others think of you.
practice: Ask each evening: when was I most myself today?
Write down one thing you learned about someone close to you.

Laguz.means: water: feelings, flow and the inner voice.
Laguz.gift: you trust your gut and go with the flow.
Laguz.shadow: getting lost in feelings, or drifting with no aim.
practice: Ask yourself: what is my gut telling me today?
Write down one feeling you had today and what it wanted to say.

Ingwaz.means: the seed: rest, inner growth and getting ready for what comes next.
Ingwaz.gift: you know when to rest and let things grow inside.
Ingwaz.shadow: waiting too long, or keeping your plans to yourself.
practice: Ask yourself: what idea is growing in me right now?
Take ten quiet minutes to rest without your phone.

Othala.means: the home: roots, family and what you pass on.
Othala.gift: you build a safe home and keep what matters.
Othala.shadow: holding on to the past, or to old family rules.
practice: Ask yourself: what from my family do I want to keep, and what do I let go?
Write down one thing that makes your home feel like home.

Dagaz.means: the day: daybreak, a big change and new hope.
Dagaz.gift: you see the light after a dark time and help others see it.
Dagaz.shadow: waiting for one big change instead of taking small steps.
practice: Each morning, ask: what is new for me today?
Write down one thing you see in a new way this week.

lifePath._about: Report-only. The owner approved them on 2026-10-27. Life path numbers, method 'reduce-parts' (month, day and year reduced on their own, 11, 22 and 33 kept). Meanings in our own words, checked against at least 2 numerology sources each.

1.means: the leader: going your own way and starting new things.
1.gift: you have the drive to start and to stand on your own feet.
1.shadow: being stubborn, or doing everything alone.

2.means: the peacemaker: working with others and keeping the peace.
2.gift: you feel what others need and bring people together.
2.shadow: being too sensitive, or putting your own needs last.

3.means: the creator: words, art, ideas and joy.
3.gift: you can lift a room and say things in a fresh way.
3.shadow: spreading yourself too thin, or hiding sadness behind a smile.

4.means: the builder: order, hard work and a steady base.
4.gift: you make plans real, one step at a time.
4.shadow: being too rigid, or working without a break.

5.means: the free spirit: change, travel and new experiences.
5.gift: you adapt fast and make life exciting.
5.shadow: getting restless, or running from what feels stuck.

6.means: the carer: home, family and looking after others.
6.gift: you make people feel safe and loved.
6.shadow: giving too much, or wanting to fix everyone.

7.means: the seeker: deep thinking, questions and inner knowing.
7.gift: you see what others miss and look for the truth.
7.shadow: pulling away from people, or not trusting anyone.

8.means: the achiever: drive, results and using your power well.
8.gift: you can lead big plans and get real results.
8.shadow: working too much, or wanting to control everything.

9.means: the giver: kindness, big ideals and helping the world.
9.gift: you care about people far beyond your own circle.
9.shadow: finding it hard to let go, or giving until you are empty.

11.means: the inspirer: strong intuition and ideas that light others up.
11.gift: you sense things early and can inspire people.
11.shadow: nerves and self-doubt, because you feel so much.
11.master: 11 is a master number. It holds the gifts of 2 with stronger intuition and higher hopes.

22.means: the master builder: big dreams made real.
22.gift: you can turn a large plan into something that lasts.
22.shadow: heavy pressure on yourself to do something huge.
22.master: 22 is a master number. It holds the gifts of 4 on a bigger scale.

33.means: the master teacher: care and kindness that help many people.
33.gift: you can heal and guide others with your warmth.
33.shadow: carrying everyone else's problems as your own.
33.master: 33 is a master number. It holds the gifts of 6 with a wider reach.
